title: Not interested
rebuttal: I wouldn't expect you to be interested before knowing whether there is anything to worry about. The damage we're seeing usually isn't causing immediate leaks, but it can create problems later. Since we're already nearby, would you be opposed to us documenting the roof for you?

title: We aren't having any problems
rebuttal: That's great to hear. The damage we're checking for often shows up before leaks do. A photo report gives you a record of the building's condition and can help prevent future claim confusion. Would it make sense to document it while we're nearby?

title: It's already been inspected
rebuttal: I'm glad you had someone look. Did they provide a photo report and a certificate of clearance showing the roof was free of storm damage?
hints: Do not insult the existing contractor

title: We have a maintenance person
prompts: We already have someone for the roof.
rebuttal: Most of our clients have a maintenance person and they're great at what they do. We're looking for a different set of storm indicators: whether the roof's lifespan was affected and whether the damage is worth documenting. Is your person a roofer, or do they handle general maintenance?

title: I'll call my insurance
prompts: I'll just call my insurance company.
My carrier can look at it.
rebuttal: You may not need to involve them yet. First, we can document whether there is anything to worry about. If there is no damage, the inspection may save everyone time; if there is, you'll have photos before deciding what to do next.

title: I don't want my premiums to go up
prompts: I don't want my premiums to go up.
rebuttal: I understand the concern. Before discussing a claim, our job is simply to document the building and help you understand whether damage exists. Coverage and premium questions should be confirmed with your licensed insurance professional. Would you be open to the inspection first?

title: I don't have time
prompts: I don't have time for this.
rebuttal: I understand—that's exactly why we handle the inspection and photo documentation. The first step doesn't require much of your time. Are you normally at the building this week, or would a quick call after the inspection be easier?
required_keywords: doesn't require much of your time
